headline: Wells Fargo says redesigning workflows with AI is its biggest area of focus
body: Faraz Shafiq, head of AI products and solutions at Wells Fargo, says redesigning workflows with AI in mind is "the biggest area of focus" in 2027.
note: For banks, a focus on workflows points to process change as much as to the choice of model.
